name: StoreRadar – Analytics for WooCommerce
author: storeradar

sections.description:
Important: This plugin requires a StoreRadar account to function.
While you can install the plugin without an account, it won’t provide any value until connected to StoreRadar. Try StoreRadar for free!

StoreRadar transforms your WooCommerce store data into actionable insights, giving you a powerful real-time dashboard that unifies your orders, customers, and products.
Make informed decisions and grow your business with data-driven strategies.

Lightning-Fast Analytics

Say goodbye to slow-loading WooCommerce reports.
StoreRadar generates detailed reports and charts in seconds, making your entire operation more efficient.

Comprehensive Dashboards

StoreRadar offers a range of customizable dashboards:

  • Sales Dashboard: Track revenue, average order value, and top-selling products in real-time. Create your custom dashboard using our drag-and-drop builder.
  • Customer Insights: Analyze customer behavior, lifetime value, and segmentation.
  • Products Insights: Find out which products are selling fast, see data by the category or other product attributes.

Subscription Analytics

For stores using WooCommerce Subscriptions,
StoreRadar provides in-depth subscription analytics. Track metrics like Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), churn rate, and lifetime value of subscription customers.

Team Collaboration

StoreRadar supports unlimited team members at no extra cost.

How It Works

  1. Sign up for a StoreRadar account at storeradar.com
  2. Install and activate the StoreRadar plugin
  3. Connect your store to your StoreRadar account
  4. Start receiving analytics and insights about your store’s performance

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce Subscriptions plugin (for subscription tracking features)
  • An active StoreRadar account

Privacy Policy

StoreRadar collects store data including:
* Cart events and contents
* Subscription events (if WooCommerce Subscriptions is installed)
* Order information
* Customer information
sections.installation:
1. Create account at storeradar.com
  2. Install the plugin
  3. Activate it. That’ it!
sections.faq:
Do I need a StoreRadar account to use this plugin?

Yes, a StoreRadar account is absolutely necessary for this plugin to function. Without an active StoreRadar account, the plugin will not provide any analytics or insights. You can sign up for an account and start a free trial at storeradar.com.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all data is transmitted securely using industry-standard encryption. StoreRadar follows best practices for data security and privacy, ensuring your store’s information is protected at all times.

Will this plugin slow down my store?

No, the plugin is designed to be lightweight and efficient.

Does this work with WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Yes, if you have WooCommerce Subscriptions installed, StoreRadar will automatically track subscription-related events and provide detailed insights about your subscription business, including MRR, churn rates, and more.

Can I customize the dashboards?

Yes, StoreRadar offers customizable dashboards. You can create your own layouts, choose which metrics to display, and save multiple dashboard configurations for different purposes or team members.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Enhanced: Improved nonce verification for better compatibility with caching plugins
  • Added: Automatic nonce refresh mechanism to handle cached pages
  • Added: Extended nonce validation (up to 5 days for heavily cached scenarios)
  • Added: Configurable tick verification depth via filter (default: 10 ticks = 5 days)
  • Added: Detailed error logging for 403 authentication failures with cache age info
  • Added: New REST API endpoint for dynamic nonce refresh
  • Improved: Better error handling and user feedback in browser console
  • Fixed: 403 Forbidden errors on sites with aggressive caching
  • Fixed: Tracking failures on sites with security plugins
  • Performance: Reduced need for nonce refresh by 90%+ with extended validation

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Real-time analytics dashboard
  • Cart tracking and abandonment recovery
  • Subscription analytics (requires WooCommerce Subscriptions)
  • Custom segmentation and reporting
  • Team collaboration features
